acceptanceBar: One shared ledger record per property accumulates its deals, flips, leases, and work orders while CRM leads, showings, rentals, and field-ops payroll all operate across the five domains from that single record — as one runnable suite.
requiredCapabilities: One shared Property Ledger record per property (ownership, address, status, full history) across brokerage, flipping, rentals, and field services
Real-estate CRM: contacts, buyer and seller leads, and a deal pipeline with stages

Showing slots (private showings and open houses) publishable from any listing, flip, or rental property; buyers book with email confirmation, reminders, calendar-sync stub, and per-property showing history with buyer feedback
Flip manager: acquisitions, renovation budgets with line items, contractor bids, flip project phases, job costing per property
Rental portfolio: leases, tenants, rent roll with payment records, maintenance requests, vacancy tracking, lease-renewal reminders

Field-ops suite: work orders raised from any property become crew task lists; crew time sheets roll into weekly payroll with rates and overtime; material/supply lists with purchase records and reorder flags

Cross-domain flows: work-order hours feed payroll and job cost; showings on flip or rental properties create CRM buyer leads; deals, flips, leases, and work orders accumulate on the shared ledger record
